title: Leji context index
description: Generated map of the context layer. Never hand-maintained; regenerate on change.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor validation and tooling.

schemaVersion.description: The Leji spec line this artifact was written against, e.g. "1.0".

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the index was generated.

generator.description: The tool that generated this index.

name.description: Name of the generating tool, e.g. "leji".

rootPath.description: The context layer root this index was generated for; mirrors the manifest's rootPath. Entry paths are repository-root-relative, not re-based under it.

entries.description: One entry per indexed document in the context layer. Each `id` and each `path` is unique across entries; the reference validator enforces this (JSON Schema cannot, since the constraint is on a sub-field, not the whole object).

id.description: Stable identifier; renames and moves update the path, never the id.

title.description: Human-readable title, from the document's first heading or frontmatter.

category.description: Which content category this document belongs to.

kind.description: Whether the document is maintained present truth (intent) or dated evidence (record). Absent means intent.

date.description: A record's date, sourced only from valid frontmatter date.

summary.description: One-line summary of the document, for routing and navigation.

lastModified.description: ISO 8601 date the document last changed, from version control where available.

contentHash.description: Hash of the document's contents, used to detect drift and stable moves.

reviewAfter.description: ISO 8601 date after which the document should be reviewed for staleness.

links.description: Optional outbound references from this document.

mounts.description: Routing records for federated sibling context layers, derived from the manifest's federation.mounts (spec: distribution.md, machine-readable-surface.md). Routing metadata only: tooling MUST NOT copy a sibling's index entries or prose here. A mount record never discloses what the host's audience may not see.

name.description: The sibling layer's name; matches the name in the sibling's own manifest.

source.description: Normalized repository locator of the sibling layer.

pin.description: Full immutable commit id (SHA-1 or SHA-256) of the sibling revision the host reads.

trackingRef.description: Fully qualified witness ref reachability and staleness are compared against, when declared.

owner.description: The owner of the sibling layer.

role.description: Prose description of what the sibling carries.

categories.description: Content-category scopes this sibling can answer for.

topics.description: Short topic labels for relevance routing.

requiredWhen.description: Task conditions under which a reader must resolve this mount or fail closed.
